original.statement: Crossplane v2.0 requires sequential upgrade through intermediate v1 minor versions, with mandatory upgrade to v1.20 as the final v1 step before upgrading to v2.0; direct upgrade from earlier v1 versions to v2.0 is not supported.

corrected.statement: Environments upgrading to Crossplane v2.0 from a version below v1.20 are exposed: they must first upgrade one minor version at a time up to v1.20, so the CRD storage migrations run at each minor release.

decision.reason: [ev-8df0afdc905e] says you should be running a v1.20 version before upgrading to v2.0, and should go through each minor version in turn because each minor upgrade migrates CRDs. So the exposed environments are the ones upgrading from a version below 1.20.0, which edge-from-version in-range "<1.20.0" captures fully. The proposed second operand misuses cluster-version for Crossplane's own version: that leaf is for the platform version. It is also redundant with the from-version edge, so it should be dropped.
